description: Phase 4: Cinematic Roulette (T7-T9b). Enhances RouletteScreen with 3-2-1 countdown + scene lighting, upgrades MobileWheel SVG with triple ring/rivets/shimmer/N-hub, creates RevealExplosion particle component, adds spring+shimmer animation to GoldenTicket. Depends on FEAT-001 for new color tokens (casinoBackground, casinoPurple, casinoGold). Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-004.
steps: T7 — Read mobile-client/src/screens/RouletteScreen.tsx. Add countdown state: const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number|null>(null). Modify handleSpin: before the API call, set countdown=3, then setTimeout(()=>setCountdown(2),900), setTimeout(()=>setCountdown(1),1800), setTimeout(()=>{setCountdown(null); /* proceed with API call */},2700). The API call and all haptic/animation start code moves inside the final timeout callback. Add bgTintAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current. After spinState becomes 'result', if rarity===EPIC or LEGENDARY, animate bgTintAnim to 1. Interpolate bgTintAnim to backgroundColor: EPIC=rgba(168,85,247,0.08), LEGENDARY=Colors.casinoGold. Apply to SafeAreaView style via Animated.View wrapper or inline style. Render countdown overlay: when countdown!==null, render an absolutely-positioned full-screen View (zIndex:100, backgroundColor:Colors.overlayDark, justifyContent/alignItems:center) with an Animated.View (spring scale from 0.5 to 1.2) containing a Text showing countdown digit in size 96 bold Colors.primary. Add import for RevealExplosion; render <RevealExplosion rarity={selectedDrink?.rarity??'COMMON'} visible={spinState==='result'} /> positioned absolutely over the wheel hero section.

T8 — Read mobile-client/src/components/roulette/MobileWheel.tsx. Add Defs and LinearGradient to imports from react-native-svg. Inside the SVG before AnimatedG, add triple gold ring circles (not rotating): Circle cx=cx cy=cy r=r stroke='#D4A340' strokeWidth=1.5 fill='none'; Circle cx=cx cy=cy r=r+3 stroke='rgba(212,163,64,0.5)' strokeWidth=1 fill='none'; Circle cx=cx cy=cy r=r+6 stroke='rgba(212,163,64,0.2)' strokeWidth=0.5 fill='none'. Add 24 rivets outside AnimatedG: map Array.from({length:24},(_,i)=>{ angle=i/24*2*Math.PI; return <Circle cx={cx+Math.cos(angle)*(r+2)} cy={cy+Math.sin(angle)*(r+2)} r=3 fill='#D4A340' /> }). Inside AnimatedG, after each segment Path add a shimmer overlay Path: same arcPath() call but with fill='rgba(255,255,255,0.1)'. Improve hub: change hubR to size/7. Add a second inner Circle (hubR-4) fill='#12121A' stroke='rgba(212,163,64,0.3)' strokeWidth=1. Add SvgText cx=cx cy=cy+1 textAnchor='middle' alignmentBaseline='middle' fill='#D4A340' fontSize=size*0.07 fontWeight='bold'>N</SvgText>. Improve pointer: replace Polygon with a Path using a diamond shape M cx,0 L cx-10,16 L cx,32 L cx+10,16 Z fill='#D4A340'. Add a shadow copy Path slightly offset: M cx+1,1 L cx-9,17 L cx+1,33 L cx+11,17 Z fill='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'.

T9a — Create mobile-client/src/components/roulette/RevealExplosion.tsx. Import View, Animated, StyleSheet from react-native. Import Svg, Circle, Line from react-native-svg. PARTICLE_COUNT = {COMMON:12, RARE:18, EPIC:24, LEGENDARY:36}. RARITY_COLORS = {COMMON:'#9b8f7d', RARE:'#38BDF8', EPIC:'#a855f7', LEGENDARY:'#D4A340'}. On visible prop becomes true: create N Animated.ValueXY(0,0) refs and N scale Animated.Values. Run Animated.stagger(30, particles.map(p => Animated.parallel([Animated.timing(p.xy, {toValue:{x:randomX,y:randomY},duration:600+random*400}), Animated.timing(p.scale,{toValue:0,duration:700})]))).start(). For LEGENDARY: also animate 3 SVG Circle rings expanding (use Animated.Value for r, interpolate 0->size*0.4,0->size*0.6,0->size*0.8) and 8 Line rays. Props: rarity:'COMMON'|'RARE'|'EPIC'|'LEGENDARY', visible:boolean. Render only when visible. Position: absolute overlay.

T9b — Read mobile-client/src/components/roulette/GoldenTicket.tsx. Add slide-up spring: const slideAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(100)).current. On component mount (useEffect[]), run Animated.spring(slideAnim,{toValue:0,friction:7,useNativeDriver:true}).start(). Wrap the card View in <Animated.View style={{transform:[{translateY:slideAnim}]}}> (replace the existing plain View card). Add shimmer loop: const shimmerAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current. Loop: Animated.loop(Animated.sequence([Animated.timing(shimmerAnim,{toValue:1,duration:1800}), Animated.timing(shimmerAnim,{toValue:0,duration:0})])).start() in useEffect[]. Add an absolutely positioned View over the card with style={{position:'absolute',top:0,left:shimmerAnim.interpolate({inputRange:[0,1],outputRange:['-100%','200%']}),width:'40%',height:'100%',backgroundColor:'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',transform:[{skewX:'-20deg'}]}}. Make countdown text color red when remainingMs < 300000: style={{color: remainingMs < 300000 ? '#ef4444' : '#D4A340'}}.
acceptance_criteria: RouletteScreen shows 3-2-1 countdown overlay before spinning
RouletteScreen background tints gold for LEGENDARY, purple for EPIC on result
RevealExplosion renders particle burst with count by rarity
MobileWheel has triple outer gold rings, 24 rivets, N center text
GoldenTicket slides up on mount with spring animation
GoldenTicket countdown text turns red when < 5 minutes remain
